definitions.explanation: The gases expelled from an engine or industrial process, typically containing pollutants.

examples.japanese: {車|くるま}の{排気|はいき}ガスは{有害|ゆうがい}だ。
{排気|はいき}ガスを{減|へ}らす{技術|ぎじゅつ}が{開発|かいはつ}された。
examples.english: Technology to reduce exhaust emissions has been developed.

examples.japanese: {都市部|としぶ}では{排気|はいき}ガスによる{大気汚染|たいきおせん}が{深刻|しんこく}だ。
examples.english: Air pollution from exhaust fumes is serious in urban areas.

notes:
{排気|はいき}ガス refers to the gases released from combustion engines or industrial equipment. It is a major contributor to air pollution.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {排気|はいき}ガスを{出|だ}す (to emit exhaust)
- {排気|はいき}ガス{規制|きせい} (exhaust emission regulations)
- {排気|はいき}ガスの{臭|にお}い (smell of exhaust fumes)

RELATED WORDS:
- {排気|はいき} (exhaust, emission)
- {排|はい}ガス (abbreviated form)
- {温室効果|おんしつこうか}ガス (greenhouse gases)
